g.text: Formal Table Mappings • Underlined Primary Keys (PK) • Directed Foreign Key Referential Actions
FORMAL 3NF RELATIONAL SCHEMA SPECIFICATION & NORMALIZATION PROOFS
USERS(user_id, full_name, email, role, dept_id*, phone, is_active)
ASSETS(asset_id, asset_tag, type, status, ip, owner_id*, crit)
TICKETS(ticket_id, code, title, asset_id*, created_by*, assigned_to*, due)
TICKET_AUDIT_LOG(log_id, ticket_id*, action, old_st, new_st, changed_by*)
All columns are atomic; composite/multivalued items normalized.
Every non-key attribute is fully functionally dependent on the entire PK.
No transitive dependencies (X → Y → Z); SLA and Dept extracted to lookup tables.
CASCADE on ticket logs, RESTRICT on departments, SET NULL on assets.
Solid underline = PK • Asterisk (*) & Arrow = Foreign Key referencing parent table PK
